extraction_notes: Digitised main-text figures showing catalytic performance: Figure 2a, Figure 2c, Figure 5c, and Figure 5d. Figure 2b was skipped because it is an Arrhenius plot; Figure 2d was skipped because it is a literature-comparison plot. Figures 3, 4, and 6 and Scheme 1 were skipped as TPD/DFT/DRIFTS/mechanistic-characterisation figures rather than direct catalytic performance. Figure 5a,b are reaction-order plots reporting ln rMeOH vs ln partial pressure; they were not represented as catalyst-performance records because the schema has no field for the varied partial pressure and the plotted quantity is logarithmic rather than a directly usable rate/STY.
